main_measure.name: ordinary t of mean of post_pipeline_value x drift-adjusted 20-bar forward return, positive-forecast 20-bar grid bars
main_measure.threshold: confirm if t >= 2 with >= 30 cases and supporting check passes; reject if t <= -2 with >= 30 cases

supporting_check.name: upper-half minus lower-half (by forecast) mean drift-adjusted 20-bar return, positive-forecast grid bars

decided_by: The main-measure t lies between -2 and 2, which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: Grid = rows 0, 20, 40, ... of each window with a full 20-bar forward return inside the window; the coin's mean 20-bar return is the mean over all its grid bars of all windows; halves split by sorted forecast into the bottom and top n//2 cases (the middle case dropped when n is odd); fewer than 30 cases is reported as 'not observable'.
